description: This file defines a theme for a Flutter application, including color schemes, input decoration styles, button styles, and custom theme extensions. It provides the primary theme configuration used across the app's UI components.

classes.name: AppPalette
classes.description: A custom ThemeExtension that provides additional color properties such as success, border, and ratingStar for use in the application's theme.

methods.name: buildAppTheme
methods.description: Constructs and returns a ThemeData object configured with specific color schemes, input styles, button styles, and extended palette for the application.
